Company Introduction:
Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.
Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.
We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”
Role Overview:
As the S&OP Principal, you will support the Taiwan S&OP process to keep our growth on track. You will co-own the full planning cycle, making sure our infrastructure, labor, and inventory stay in sync to meet customer demand. You will act as the network gatekeeper, ensuring we scale up without hitting capacity limits. Your main goal is to project daily, weekly, and monthly volumes and match them with designed capacity, while automating manual tasks to streamline our workflows.
What You Will Do:
Volume & capacity planning: Support daily volume projections and capacity planning to ensure the network remains fluid and performance targets are met
Peak season strategy: Develop forecasting models for peak (6.18, 11.11), predicting not just daily volume, but hourly volume distributions
PvA (Plan vs. Actual) analysis: Conduct regular PvA analysis to identify improvement opportunities
Scenario analysis: Build 'what-if' scenarios to test the demand plan against warehouse and logistics capacity constraints
Stakeholder management: Act as the central point between Instock, Ops, Labor Planning, and Finance to align on a single version of the truth for demand and supply planning
Basic Qualifications
Experience with Excel, statistical modeling, and optimization.
Strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes, including demand planning, inventory management, logistics, and distribution.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills, capable of building relationships with internal teams and external partners. Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with a customer-centric mindset.
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, or related field; MBA or relevant advanced degree preferred.
Extensive experience in supply chain management, operations, forecasting, and capacity management.
Experience in data processing and analysis, with the ability to draw conclusion from data and build basic models to support business decision-making.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. We are seeking an experienced and strategic IP Counsel to join our growing legal team. 10+ years of legal experience with demonstrated expertise across the IP spectrum particularly in patents

Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field
Deep expertise in one or more IP areas beyond patents
Experience with AI, machine learning, or related cutting-edge technologies

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. 회사 소개
쿠팡페이의 핀테크 사업은 금융 서비스의 재정의를 통해 쿠팡 고객과 판매자들이 동일한 비용으로 더 많은 가치를 누리도록 지원합니다. 쿠팡페이는 쿠팡 앱 및 홈페이지에서 상품을 구매하는 소비자와 쿠팡 마켓플레이스에서 사업을 영위하는 판매자, 쿠팡이츠에 입점한 음식점주 등에게 혁신적인 결제 및 금융 솔루션을 제공하는 데 최선을 다합니다. 쿠팡페이의 최신 핀테크 혁신 기술은 원터치 결제 서비스가 탑재된 자체 결제 시스템 쿠페이를 기반으로 한국과 대만 소비자들의 니즈에 부응하고 있습니다. 대표적으로 쿠팡페이는 고객 가치 지향 차원에서 업계 최고 수준의 리워드를 제공하는 쿠팡와우카드(쿠팡 전용 제휴 카드)를 빠르게 확장시키고 있습니다. 또 마켓플레이스 판매자들을 위해 BaaS (Banking as a Service) 모델을 접목하고 다양한 유동성 강화 솔루션을 제공함으로써 소상공인들의 사업 성장을 적극 지원합니다. 보유하고 계신 다양한 경험을 핀테크 분야에서 최대한 살리고 싶다면 쿠팡페이와 함께 하세요. 쿠팡페이는 고객들의 결제 시간을 최대한 아껴주고 좋아하는 것을 마음껏 쇼핑할 시간을 벌어드립니다.
직무 소개
쿠팡페이의 Back-end Engineer(SDET)는 프로덕트 사양, 기술 구현, UI 설계, 기능 및 성능 측면에서 제품의 품질을 평가하여 업무와 관련된 팀에게 의미 있는 피드백 및 프로덕트 품질 향상을 위한 업무를 진행합니다. 쿠팡페이의 Back-end 엔지니어는 프로덕트 배포 이전의 중요한 게이트키퍼 역할을 담당합니다.
업무 내용
Test Strategy and Planning
- 제품 요구사항과 기술적 위험을 기반으로 테스트 범위와 자동화 전략을 수립합니다. 테스트 대상의 우선순위와 완료 기준을 정의하고, 회사의 품질 기준 및 관련 규제 요구사항이 테스트 계획에 반영될 수 있도록 합니다.
Test Automation Development
- Selenium, Appium, Playwright 등의 도구를 활용하여 UI, 모바일 및 API 테스트 자동화 프레임워크와 테스트 코드를 설계하고 구현합니다. 반복적인 수작업 테스트를 줄이고 테스트 커버리지와 테스트 코드의 재사용성 및 유지보수성을 높입니다.
CI/CD Pipeline Integration
- 자동화 테스트를 CI/CD 파이프라인에 통합하고 테스트 실행 조건 및 품질 게이트를 구성합니다. 테스트 결과를 신속하게 피드백하여 결함을 조기에 발견하고 안정적인 배포를 지원합니다.
API and End-to-End Testing
- 실제 사용자 및 결제 시나리오를 기반으로 API와 End-to-End(E2E) 테스트를 설계하고 수행합니다. 정상 결제뿐만 아니라 실패, 취소, 환불, 재처리 등 주요 예외 흐름과 시스템 간 연동의 안정성을 검증합니다.
Test Data Management
- 여러 도메인에 걸친 결제 플랫폼 테스트에 적합하도록 테스트 데이터의 정확성, 최신성 및 적합성을 유지하며 관리합니다.
Collaborate with Cross-functional Teams
- 엔지니어링 팀과 긴밀히 협력하여 테스트 요구사항을 정의하고 테스트의 우선순위를 설정하며, 각 스프린트에 품질이 내재화될 수 있도록 보장합니다.
자격
요건
5년 이상의 소프트웨어 엔지니어 또는 테스터 경력이 있는 분
소프트웨어 개발 라이프 사이클(Software Development Life Cycle) 전반에 걸쳐 품질관리 경험이 있는 분

프로그래밍 언어에 대한 기본 지식이 있으신 분 (Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java 등)

영어로 기본적인 업무 소통 및 커뮤니케이션이 가능한 분
유연하고 독립적으로 업무가 가능하고, 자기 동기 부여가 가능한 분
빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 여러 경쟁 우선 순위를 처리 할 수 있는 능력이 있는 분

jobs.description: Amazon builds fast—and behind every new Fulfillment Center, Sortation Center, Delivery Station, and capital investment is a critical question: Are we buying the right solution at the right price? We're looking for a Cost & Value Engineering Manager to partner with Amazon's North America Engineering, Design, and Operations stakeholders, delivering equipment cost engineering and value engineering services that optimize equipment design, validate costs, and inform capital investment decisions across Amazon's fulfillment network. This role is high-impact, high-variety, and technically demanding. You'll develop bottom-up cost estimates, should-cost models, and Value Engineering analyses across a diverse portfolio of material handling equipment (MHE), automation, and auxiliary equipment, including conveyance, chutes, platforms, mezzanines, and related fulfillment systems. From multi-site retrofit programs to complex, one-off initiatives, you'll evaluate equipment design alternatives, optimize specifications, identify cost drivers, and produce defensible cost models that shape sourcing, design, and investment decisions. Working from early concepts through supplier selection and implementation, you'll apply technical engineering expertise to balance cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements. As part of Amazon's Global Procurement Organization within the Sourcing Excellence pillar, you'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Operations, Procurement, and Category teams to ensure Amazon is buying the right equipment at the right price. You'll also collaborate with AI and Market Intelligence Solutions, leveraging AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, develop scalable cost intelligence, and advance next-generation automation that expands the reach and impact of Cost & Value Engineering across Amazon. This role is high-impact, high-variety, and technically demanding. You'll develop bottom-up cost estimates, should-cost models, and Value Engineering analyses across a diverse portfolio of building types, material handling equipment (MHE), automation, and capital projects. From multi-site retrofit programs to complex, one-off initiatives, you'll evaluate design alternatives, optimize specifications, identify cost drivers, and produce defensible cost models that shape sourcing, design, and investment decisions. Working from early concepts through bid-ready construction documents, you'll apply technical expertise to balance cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements. As part of Amazon's Global Procurement Organization within the Sourcing Excellence pillar, you'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Construction, Procurement, and Category teams to ensure Amazon is buying the right solution at the right price. You'll also collaborate with AI and Market Intelligence Solutions, leveraging AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, develop scalable cost intelligence, and advance next-generation automation that expands the reach and impact of Cost & Value Engineering across Amazon. Key job responsibilities - Deliver independent, bottom-up cost estimates for material handling equipment, automation, auxiliary equipment, and capital investment projects across Amazon's global fulfillment portfolio, spanning retrofit, expansion, new-build, automation, and equipment deployment initiatives. - Develop cost estimates from early-stage equipment concepts through supplier selection and implementation, adapting methodologies and analytical depth to available project information and design maturity. - Build and maintain scalable estimating models and templates while developing detailed bottom-up cost models for complex, site-specific initiatives requiring advanced analytical judgment. - Perform should-cost modeling, benchmarking, and Value Engineering analyses to evaluate equipment design alternatives, optimize specifications, identify cost drivers, and ensure Amazon is buying the right solution at the right price. Leverage AI-powered tools to automate data gathering, cost modeling, benchmarking, and pattern recognition while applying engineering judgment to validate outputs and resolve complex or ambiguous equipment scopes. - Drive the development of scalable AI-enabled cost intelligence solutions by curating equipment and market data, validating model performance, and identifying opportunities to automate routine analytical activities. - Partner with Engineering, Design, Operations, Procurement, Category Management, and business stakeholders to validate assumptions, communicate cost risks, evaluate alternatives, and influence sourcing and investment decisions. Peer review cost models, estimates, and Value Engineering recommendations to ensure technical rigor, consistency, and alignment with current market conditions and best practices. About the team The Sourcing Excellence team helps Amazon answer two fundamental questions: Are we buying the right product? (Value Engineering) and Are we paying the right price? (Cost Engineering). Value Engineering ensures Amazon is investing in the right material handling equipment, automation, auxiliary equipment, and technologies by optimizing specifications, design, materials, and performance to maximize business value while meeting operational requirements. jobs.description: About the Role As a senior content designer within our Experience Design organization, you will own how our brands sound in the product experience. You will work across the brand journey leads and the design system team, and you will help decide what content is shared across brands and what stays brand-distinct. Getting there is as much facilitation as writing: sitting with people who have competing brand interests, finding the answer that serves the customer, and writing it down so that it holds. You will thrive in an environment where the distance from conversation to prototype to insight is measured in hours, not weeks, and AI is the accelerant. AI will write plausible copy at volume all day, which makes judgment about what is worth saying the scarce skill rather than the throughput. You see AI as a craft multiplier, and you are clear about where human judgment and real customer evidence still have to do the work. You can write with brand personality and you can write a clear error message, and you know which one the moment calls for A facilitator. You can say when consistency serves the customer and when brand expression must take priority Comfortable working inside a product operating model, partnering with Product Management and Engineering rather than receiving requirements from them Data-informed. You test language, you measure what changed, and you can explain the impact to partners in their language Hands-on and fast.
